text: Not able to match a reverse transaction of a previously matched transaction
Make sure the the online id is unset in the reverse transaction

As an example, consider an imported credit card purchase transaction for items you subsequently decide to return.  If you use reverse transaction to enter the reimbursement, the new transaction erroneously maintains the original online id which will prevent the new transaction from being available to be matched on a subsequent import.  To work-around the issue, you may use duplicate transaction to clear the online id.
